test_title: PYST 36: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Give someone a taste of their own medicine

options.text: Mistreat someone in the same way they have treated others

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mistreat someone in the same way they have treated others**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Idioms **are a collection of words established by usage as having a meaning distinct from the meanings of the individual words.
 
• The** meaning of the above idiom** is treating someone the same way they treat others.
 
• Some *examples *if idioms are a** piece of cake, go down in flames , on cloud nine.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Some more keywords on word **medicine **are :

 
• Laughter is the best medicine - laughing is healthy

*Example *: My teacher told me** laughter is the best medicine.**

 
• In the best of health - Very healthy

*Example *: Lisa is in** the best of health** after her recovery.

 
• Feel on the Top of world - Feeling very healthy

*Example *: I **feel on the top of the world** after taking these medicines.
